newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Hoare cuts UK electronics forecasts.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hoare cuts UK electronics forecasts.

text.p: Analysts at Hoare Govett have cut their 1997 earnings forecasts for Britain's electronics sector to reflect sterling's strength, market sources said on Wednesday.
The sources said Hoare Govett expected sector earnings to fall two percent in the six months to June. Earnings growth for 1997 as a whole was seen at just one percent.
Among forecasts for individual companies, Delta Plc was downgraded by eight percent and rated "overvalued", Bowthorpe Holdings Plc was downgraded six percent and rated "hold", the sources said.

GEC and BICC both had their profit forecasts downgraded by five percent and were rated "buy". Eurotherm Plc, downgraded by four percent, and Astec (BSR) Plc, downgraded by three percent, were also both rated "buy".
Racal Electronics Plc had its 1997 profit forecast shaved by one percent and was rated "sell" by Hoare Govett, the sources said.
